initialAttempt.scope: Fresh v4 allowlisted source copy, fresh Python environment and node_modules; local Anvil and injected Chrome only. No personal wallet or public writes.

repair: The initial fresh environment was retained; its Windows-blocked PyCryptodome 3.24.1 dependency was replaced by constrained 3.24.0. tmp was corrected to 0.2.7 after a new advisory lookup. No security policy was disabled.

checks: Injected EIP-6963 test-provider connection and real Flask health
Account reselection uses wallet_requestPermissions; same-account, declined, pending and unsupported results are explicit and preserve the connection
Pending account selection disables conflicting controls, ignores duplicate clicks and never submits a transaction
Balance read failure preserves the wallet connection and explicit refresh visibly recovers
Review, exact one-wei invoice creation, receipt and state confirmation
Switch to client wallet selects received invoices and reopens the exact invoice without sending payment
Client account switch, exact payment, issuer balance increase, paid-state controls and real event history
390px viewport has no horizontal overflow
Switch to issuer wallet reopens the same Paid invoice in the issuer view
Wrong network disables writes and explicit switch recovers
UI rejects exponent, zero amount and self-client before wallet submission
Wallet rejection does not create an invoice or a false success
Public reference is text, issuer cancellation is confirmed, terminal controls removed
Reload restores an already-authorized wallet and Connected label without another account permission prompt
Disconnect revokes site permission, survives reload and preserves the submitted hash for explicit reconnect and recovery
Pending transaction survives reload and is confirmed from the receipt without resending
Network change immediately after wallet submission preserves the hash, original chain and backend-verified receipt
Unexpected wallet chain is rejected before submission even when no chainChanged event arrives
Restored wallet cannot hide RPC health failure; explicit successful refresh clears the error and restores controls without submitting a transaction
Account changes close stale creation and payment reviews without submitting an old action
Unsupported revocation leaves explicit local disconnection; late balance/account responses and reload cannot silently reconnect
Disconnect in another tab immediately clears this tab account and write controls
All three status filters use genuine local invoice states, preserve account total/page range and submit no transaction
Payment and cancellation details/activity use their on-chain creation/settlement times with an explicit time zone; the filter has a keyboard focus and scope label
Filtered empty later page retains its correct range and account total; pagination is disabled while loading and preserves the selected filter
Failed page clears obsolete counts and permits Previous recovery; role change resets filter and clears the old page
Account change resets the filter and discards a delayed previous-account list without restoring old Paid records
Status filters, honest pagination and activity times fit a 390px viewport without horizontal overflow
Genuinely underfunded local issuer receives amount-and-fee guidance with no hash, invoice or successful broadcast
Receipt API failure retains the mined transaction hash, blocks duplicate writes and recovers the same receipt without resending
No uncaught browser JavaScript errors
Selecting an already-authorized second account clears a stale review without a transaction or permission request.
Explicit second-account preference survives reload while still authorized.
Authorized account order changes preserve the explicitly selected client.
Revocation while account selection is reading discards the late authorized snapshot and retains the valid account.
Cross-tab disconnect during a delayed selection clears the preference and ignores the late response across reload.
Second exposed account signs the exact local payment; requested from, transfer and Paid receipt/state agree.
Already-authorized invoice handoff changes role and restores the same Paid record without another permission prompt.
Removing selected wallet permission clears the preference and prevents later silent reselection.
Tampered stored preference cannot add or select an address outside current wallet authorization.
Permission loss during signer lookup cannot trigger an implicit reconnection or transaction.
Fresh authorization check blocks a revoked selected address immediately before wallet submission.
A network change without a provider event is blocked before any wallet submission.
The full-address account selector fits a 390px viewport.
Disconnect and reload remove the preference and account choices.
